abyssinian.description: One of the oldest known cat breeds, with a distinctive ticked coat that gives it a wild appearance.

american_bobtail.description: A sturdy, medium-to-large cat with a naturally short, bobbed tail and a wild appearance.

american_shorthair.description: An easygoing and adaptable breed, known for its robust health and excellent hunting skills.

bengal.description: A hybrid breed with a wild, leopard-like spotted or marbled coat pattern and a muscular build.

birman.description: A color-pointed cat with silky fur, deep blue eyes, and distinctive white gloves on each paw.

bombay.description: A sleek, jet-black cat bred to resemble a miniature panther with striking copper or gold eyes.

british_shorthair.description: A sturdy, round-faced breed known for its dense plush coat and calm, easygoing personality.

egyptian_mau.description: The fastest domestic cat breed, naturally spotted with a graceful, muscular body and gooseberry-green eyes.

maine_coon.description: One of the largest domesticated cat breeds, known for its tufted ears, bushy tail, and gentle giant personality.

persian.description: A long-haired breed with a flat face, round eyes, and a luxurious flowing coat that requires daily grooming.

ragdoll.description: A large, blue-eyed breed known for going limp when picked up, with a semi-long silky coat.

russian_blue.description: An elegant breed with a short, dense blue-gray coat, vivid green eyes, and a shy but loyal nature.

siamese.description: An ancient breed with striking blue almond-shaped eyes, a sleek body, and a loud, distinctive voice.

sphynx.description: A hairless breed known for its wrinkled skin, large ears, and extroverted clownish personality.

tuxedo.description: Not a specific breed, but a striking bi-color coat pattern resembling a formal tuxedo suit.
tuxedo.temperament: Varies by breed, often friendly and outgoing
